senses.definition: (now only in dialects) A meadow, especially a low meadow near a river; water meadow.
examples: Ings, glens, and fens of the Highlands.
[There] lay an extent of meadow grounds, in ings, to afford a supply of hay.

quotes.text: Bill for dividing and inclosing certain open common fields, ings, common pastures, and other commonable lands.
quotes.reference: 1773, Journals of the House of Commons:

senses.definition: The letter for the ng sound /ŋ/ in Pitman shorthand.
